input.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

This isn't actually in the CSV writer. `dedupeKey` in `src/ingest/dedupe.ts` builds its key from `date`, `amount` and `description` only (`[t.date, t.amount, t.description].join("|")`), ignoring `currency`. Since transactions started carrying a currency, two rows that differ only by currency now hash to the same dedupe key and one gets dropped during ingestion, before the CSV export ever sees it. The key needs to include `currency` as well.

text: Found it — the actual bug is in `src/ingest/dedupe.ts`, where `dedupeKey` doesn't include currency, so transactions with same date/amount/description but different currencies are treated as duplicates and merged during ingestion (not in csv.ts as the reporter assumed).
